name: 77807 · Bryan, TX
findings: ZIP 77807 (Bryan) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77807 (Bryan) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77807 (Bryan) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77807 (Bryan) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
